item.title: DOC officials rebut DHS claims that over 1,300 incarcerated people have ICE detainers
item.description: While DHS says there are "more than 1,360 active detainers for criminals in Minnesota jails,” DOC officials refute that number, stating there are fewer than 500 incarcerated people in the state with active ICE detainers. 380 of those people are in Minnesota state prisons, 270 of whom have active detainers.
